---
name: Request a new document type
about: A type the library does not cover
title: "type: <name>"
labels: new-type
---

**Read this first, because it will probably save you time.**

A new document type has to pass ADR 0030's admission test: **a named source must publish it as a written
document**. Not as a practice, not as a canvas, not as a board, not as a tool. A document.

That test has rejected real candidates. `wireframe` and `interactive-prototype` were excluded because their
artifacts are visual and executable. `prototype-brief` was researched across six dimensions and 29 sources
and rejected because prototyping practice is everywhere and a commissioning *document* is nowhere.

**The type, and what it is for.**

**A named source that publishes it as a written document.** A standard, a methodology, a book, or a named
practitioner's published template. A vendor template counts but is weak evidence on its own.

**What it would carry that no existing bundle carries.** The catalog holds 205 types and 26 are built.
Overlap with an existing bundle is the usual reason a request does not proceed.
